turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? A zero on Owen's essay, and nobody called me first.
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
Nothing in front of his class. Take the zero off first, then you apologise to him in private.
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
Those are your words to write, Hale. Put the zero's withdrawal in an email to me tonight, and then say what you like to him.
